event_name: Date 26 October 2019 Time 15:12 2019 MEXICAN GRAND PRIX 24 - 27 October 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 19 & 20) and heard from the drivers and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine
offence: Alleged breach of Article 28.13 (a) of the 2019 FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the drivers of Car 26 (Daniil Kvyat) and Car 3 (Daniel Ricciardio) and the team representatives. It was apparent that Car 26 was released from the garage almost simultaneously with Car 3. Car 3 did not have to take avoiding action, both drivers agreed that the situation was not significant, and the Stewards determined to take no further action.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 26 Alleged Unsafe Release
